evidence.name: Customer Assistance Program (CAP)
evidence.eligibility: Households that receive Medicaid, SNAP, or other qualifying assistance, or whose income is at or below 200% of the federal poverty level, may qualify.

programs.how_to_apply: Apply online at https://www.austintexas.gov/cap/apply or call 512-494-9400.
programs.benefit_summary: 10% discount on electric charges and reduced water and wastewater fees.
programs.summary: The Customer Assistance Program (CAP) helps income-qualified Austin Energy and Austin Water customers reduce their monthly electric, water, and wastewater bills.
